name: rankforge
description: RankForge — Production-ready commercial SEO Automation SaaS

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:security && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npx tsx tests/unit/ssrf.test.ts && npx tsx tests/unit/audit.test.ts && npx tsx tests/unit/credit.test.ts
scripts.test:security: npx tsx tests/security/tenant-isolation.test.ts && npx tsx tests/security/cross-tenant.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: npx tsx tests/integration/auth.test.ts && npx tsx tests/integration/project.test.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:security && npm run test:integration
scripts.docker:build: docker build -t rankforge-web . && docker build -t rankforge-api -f apps/api/Dockerfile .
